title: An Adaptive Large Neighborhood Search Heuristic for the Pickup and Delivery Problem with Time Windows
verified_evidence: Competing destroy and repair subheuristics are selected according to past performance; source method for regret repair.
limitation: Static PDPTW; no E7 state inheritance, energy, fairness or carbon semantics.

title: An adaptive large neighborhood search heuristic for dynamic vehicle routing problems
verified_evidence: Dynamic hard-time-window VRP decomposed into static slices; ad hoc destroy/repair, periodic perturbation and insertion feasibility check.
limitation: No verified official code; single-depot and no electric charging or responsibility sharing.

title: An adaptive large neighborhood search for the multi-depot dynamic vehicle routing problem with time windows
verified_evidence: Re-optimization as deterministic multi-period mixed-fleet MD-VRPTW; current customers may become vehicle-specific depots; two removal operators and Nagata-based O(1) insertion-position feasibility update.
limitation: O(1) applies to a position-level feasibility update, not total search; no verified code; no ReSETP energy/fairness semantics.

title: Route Stability in Dynamic Vehicle Routing: A Bi-Objective Approach
verified_evidence: Bi-objective pBiALNS minimizes route cost and route changes; route change measured by Levenshtein edit distance; non-dominated solutions explored in parallel.
limitation: Conference paper; no verified official implementation; route matching and quadratic edit-distance cost need care.

title: An event-driven optimization framework for dynamic vehicle routing
verified_evidence: Event-driven decision framework and parallel dynamic optimization support separating event handling from routing search.
limitation: No verified reusable code and stochastic anticipation is outside the frozen E7 information boundary unless separately approved.

title: New online reinsertion approaches for a dynamic Dial-a-Ride Problem
verified_evidence: HDR uses destroy/repair; GH and IGH use ejection chains for real-time rejected-request reinsertion.
limitation: Dial-a-ride constraints differ from delivery; no verified source code; ejection branching must be bounded.

title: Adaptive Large Neighborhood Search with a Constant-Time Feasibility Test for the Dial-a-Ride Problem
verified_evidence: Supports label-based constant-time position feasibility tests under rich route constraints.
limitation: DARP-specific formulas require re-derivation; constant-time position test does not make full search constant time.

title: A review of dynamic vehicle routing problems
verified_evidence: Defines dynamic VRP taxonomy, degree of dynamism and common solution frameworks.

title: dvrpsim
verified_evidence: Official code exports time, vehicle status, carried orders, previous/current visit and open orders; routing callback measures real elapsed seconds; external algorithms supported.
limitation: Simulator and state interface only; it does not provide a high-performance routing policy.

title: PyVRP
verified_evidence: pyvrp.solve accepts an optional initial_solution and runs local search/ILS from it.
limitation: Warm start is not hard route freezing; native model does not cover ReSETP nonlinear charging, fairness and full carbon semantics.

title: RoutingBlocks
verified_evidence: Official docs show EVRP-TW-PR ALNS examples; source exposes StationVicinityRemovalOperator, RelatedRemovalOperator and BestInsertionOperator.
limitation: No root LICENSE file; last inspected branch is old; no dynamic state or route freezing implementation.

title: ALNS Python library
verified_evidence: Provides initial-state iteration, operator selection including AlphaUCB and roulette schemes, acceptance criteria and runtime/iteration stopping.
limitation: Generic framework only; using it does not itself constitute dynamic or problem-specific innovation.

title: OR-Tools RoutingModel partial-route locks and assignment warm start
verified_evidence: routing.h documents ApplyLocksToAllVehicles for already-driven route parts and SolveFromAssignmentWithParameters/FastSolveFromAssignmentWithParameters for initial assignments.
limitation: Generic RoutingModel; complete ReSETP energy, charging, fairness and carbon semantics would require substantial custom modeling and independent recalc.

title: Timefold Solver real-time planning
verified_evidence: Official docs describe real-time planning as continuous planning with short planning windows; official repository supports routing.
limitation: Java/Kotlin stack and generic score model; no verified direct operator transplant into the Python ALNS; not recommended as first prototype.

title: A review and ranking of operators in adaptive large neighborhood search for vehicle routing problems
verified_evidence: Review identifies sequence removals as strong and foresight/regret insertions as leading operator classes across VRP ALNS literature.
limitation: Cross-problem frequency/ranking does not guarantee effectiveness on E7 and cannot replace a paired mechanism ablation.
